headline: Dropbox says its 45-minute outage on Nov 20 was not a cyberattack. It has not said what caused it.
summary: First draft. 5 sources (3 Tier 1, 2 Tier 3), 8 claims (4 Confirmed, 4 Not established), 5 questions. The outage and its times are confirmed by Dropbox's own status page. The denial of a cyberattack is Dropbox's own statement and no independent source backs it, so the main question is labelled Reported. No cause, user count or post-incident report found. No link to other outages is shown. Dropbox Sign was named in a request but is not on the status page, so it is not listed. Privacy check done: no names of private people, no handles, no contact details.
author: Research agent
